rec.name: Homepage Testimonial Masonry Wall with Customer Photos and Verified Buyer Reviews
rec.status: Reference only (example from desktronic.de, no build notes)

what.text: A homepage testimonials section laid out as a 4-column masonry grid of review cards. Each card shows a customer-submitted photo (the product in a real home or office setup) and, below it, the reviewer name, review date, a green 'Verified Buyer' badge (labelled in German) and a short quote. Some cards are photo-only. The grid is cut off by a fade-out gradient with a pill-shaped 'Read more' button with a down arrow, which expands the wall to show more reviews. The ticket title mentions 'video & text' reviews, but the screenshot only shows photo and text cards.

why.text: Real customer photos and honest quotes show the product in everyday settings, which makes the reviews more credible than polished marketing imagery. The 'Verified Buyer' badge reduces doubt about whether the reviews are fake. The quotes address typical purchase objections: easy assembly, fair price, quality, shipping. Visual variety invites browsing, and the truncated grid with a 'Read more' button keeps the page short while signalling that many more reviews exist.

how.text: Build a custom section (or use a UGC/reviews app widget) with a CSS multi-column or masonry grid, 4 columns on desktop and 1-2 on mobile. Each card is a block with an image, name, date, verified badge and quote text; photo-only cards are allowed. Limit the container height with an overflow-hidden wrapper and a white-to-transparent gradient overlay. Add a 'Read more' pill button that removes the height limit or loads more cards. Feed content from blocks, metaobjects or a reviews app that supplies photos, video and a verified flag.

items: Initial visible height before the fade-out
Card content: photo, name, date, verified badge, quote
Verified Buyer badge on/off and label text
'Read more' button label and behaviour (expand vs. load more)
Support for video cards (implied by the ticket title)
Review source (manual blocks, metaobjects or reviews app)

dependencies.text: Customer photos/videos and reviews must be collected, for example via a reviews/UGC app (Judge.me, Loox, Yotpo or similar) or a metaobject list. A verified-purchase flag is needed for the badge. Theme assumed to support custom sections with CSS columns. Specific apps are not named in the ticket.

items: Click-through from the homepage to PDP/collection
Click rate on the 'Read more' button
Scroll depth to the testimonials section
Add-to-cart rate for sessions that view the section

images.caption: Masonry testimonial wall with customer photos, names, dates, 'Verified Buyer' badges and quotes, faded out at the bottom with a 'Read more' button
Verified Buyer badge and short quotes addressing assembly, price and quality
Fade-out gradient with a pill 'Read more' button to expand the grid
